findings.business_impact: The automation issued a refund after the shipment had already left the controllable fulfillment stage. This can create money-plus-goods loss and manual recovery work.
findings.recommendation: When an order is shipped or carrier-scanned, create an approval request and hold the refund until a reviewer confirms the correct after-shipment action.

findings.business_impact: The automation issued a high-value refund without approval, increasing avoidable cash-loss and fraud risk.
findings.recommendation: Route refunds at or above the high-value threshold into an approval workflow before issuing money back to the buyer.
